coaching.headline: Lost the map 1–6 on towers and 8–25 on objectives — a 27-minute macro loss with no healers to blame, just lost neutrals and fights.
coaching.team: No enemy healers, so this was purely losing the objective and tower war. Two lanes read favored — Shinbi offlane and Argus mid — and the rest were behind, but we never contested neutrals (8-25) or held a tower (1-6). Everyone was on a sensible lane — this is a fight/macro loss, not a lineup one. Win a Fangtooth and a fight before committing.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: Don't fight for objectives we can't win — we lost neutrals 8–25. Play for vision and picks, then take the Fangtooth off the back of a kill.

perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Shinbi offlane was Cuban Noobster's favored lane (2/5) — Cuban built the Orb core; just lost the matchup on the scoreboard.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Steel support into The Fey — 6 deaths; the frontline's job was to peel, not to trade into poke.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Argus mid held a favored read into Legion (5/4/8); the loss was the team's objective and tower war (8-25, 1-6).
perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Drongo carry 7/4 into an unfavored GRIM.exe — Goldilocks324's scoreline held up, but the macro flags him at 24.4: alive and never joining the 1-3 at their Orb Prime that preceded Orb Prime at 25. The map (8-25 objectives) needed the carry at that fight.
perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Boris jungle (7/7) into a Serath read 'theirs all game' — the seven deaths all came in team fights, with the 19.2, 24.4 and 26.4 falls priced at Fangtooth, Orb Prime and Primal Fangtooth; the fix is fight selection, not pathing.

threats: Dive threat on our backline: Serath. Assign peel for the carry and ward the flanks.
synergy: Little hard CC on our side — we can't force a pick. Play for poke/objectives and punish their cooldowns, don't flip coin-toss 5v5s.
We have sustain (Steel) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Detection Protocol track → Chrono Swipe → Primeval Roar shield → Ursine Burst grab ult
ourKits.winCondition: grab a key target out of position and burst them down
ourKits.playWith: a team that collapses on his grabbed target
ourKits.playAgainst: his grab ult is the whole threat — bait it / stay spaced; CC during Primeval Roar

ourKits.combo: Old Rusty slow → Gag Grenade silence → Rad Rounds basics → Shrapnel Cannon armor shred
ourKits.winCondition: kite back, stack Wastelander bleed and Rad Rounds, melt from range
ourKits.playWith: peel and frontline so he can free-fire
ourKits.playAgainst: low mobility — dive him or break LoS through his poke; he folds to hard engage

ourKits.combo: Rushing Beat dashes → Line Tempo wolves → Circle Rhythm shield → All-Kill! wolfpack ult
ourKits.winCondition: stack Track and unleash All-Kill! in a grouped fight
ourKits.playAgainst: spread vs the wolfpack; she's squishy without her shield up

ourKits.combo: Bull Rush knockback → Force Shield wall → Shield Slam knockup+stun ult, Shield Bash %hp
ourKits.winCondition: peel the carry with walls/knockups or engage with Shield Slam
ourKits.playWith: a carry he can wall for and peel
ourKits.playAgainst: his Force Shield blocks projectiles — reposition around it; bait Shield Slam

ourKits.combo: Dread Nova stun → Ether Crystal push/lift → Particle Shredder channel → Synaptic Obliterator beams
ourKits.winCondition: poke from max range and zone with the crystal
ourKits.playWith: a frontline to protect his stationary channel
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Dread Nova; dive him during the immobile ult channel

enemyKits.combo: stance-swap with Zero Shift → Tachyon Lance (ranged) or melee chain → Limit Break on Overheat
enemyKits.winCondition: build Heat and burst with Limit Break, flexing range and melee
enemyKits.passive: damage builds Heat → Overheat unlocks Limit Break
enemyKits.playWith: peel that lets her ramp Heat safely
enemyKits.playAgainst: pressure her before Overheat; CC during the melee stance

enemyKits.combo: Energy Shield block → Displacement Blast → Assault Mode → GTFO lockon ult
enemyKits.winCondition: out-trade with Pulsefire and the spell-shield, finish with GTFO
enemyKits.playWith: peel so he can free-cast in Assault Mode
enemyKits.playAgainst: bait Energy Shield, then commit; dodge GTFO's slow channel

enemyKits.combo: Bramble Patch slow → Harvest Nettles stacks → Untamed Growth DoT → Fly Trap pull ult
enemyKits.winCondition: Fly Trap a clumped team and detonate AoE on the pull
enemyKits.passive: takedowns spawn growths + grant move speed
enemyKits.playWith: engage that clumps for her Fly Trap
enemyKits.playAgainst: spread out vs the pull; she's squishy — dive her

enemyKits.combo: Ascend dive → Heaven's Fury multi-strike → Chastise slow → Heresy form ult, resets on takedowns
enemyKits.winCondition: dive the backline and snowball Heresy resets
enemyKits.playWith: a frontline that creates her dive angle
enemyKits.playAgainst: peel the backline — deny the first kill and her resets dry up

loadout.name: Wrath Unleashed
loadout.text: Applying an On-Hit Effect to an Enemy Hero grants +0.75% Attack Speed for 3s, stacking infinitely.
loadout.plain: Each on-hit effect on a hero grants stacking attack speed. Chastise and Heaven's Fury both apply on-hit, so combos plus Heresy attacks ramp her attack speed quickly.

loadout.name: Vermis
loadout.text: Every 3rd consecutive Basic Attack on the same Enemy Hero within 2.5s deals 3% (+0.25% per Level) of their Max Health as bonus Physical Damage.
loadout.plain: Every third basic attack in a row on the same hero deals a chunk of their max health. Chastise resets your attack timer, so you reach the third hit fast, great against tanks.

loadout.name: Serration
loadout.text: Vermis also deals 3.5% of the target's Missing Health as bonus Physical Damage.
loadout.plain: Vermis also takes some of the target's missing health. It turns your third hit into a finisher on wounded targets.

loadout.name: Melting Point
loadout.text: Deal 10% bonus damage to targets with more than 125 Physical Armor.
loadout.plain: Bonus damage against targets with high physical armor. Take it when the enemy front line is stacking armor.

loadout.name: Pacifier
loadout.text: Adrenalize:  Dash a short distance. Empower your next Physical Damage Instance within 3s. Deals 30 (+25%) Damage. Increased by 2.5x against Targets below 20% Max Health. Killing a Hero within 3s allows Adrenalize to be recast for 6s.
loadout.plain: A short dash that empowers your next physical hit, much stronger below 20% health. Use it to catch a fleeing target, and a kill lets you recast it.

fedBy: Fallen Grace (passive): Takedowns on Enemy Heroes leave behind a demonic visage for 10s. Upon touching it, Serath activates Heresy at no cost and reduces her current basic ability cooldowns by 65%.
lines: Lead story: Damage well above normal. 1,299 hero damage a minute, more than 94% of Serath jungle players this patch (27% of the team's). The damage came from Manta Scythe, Sky Splitter, Rapture.
18 takedowns (12 kills, 6 assists) fed: Fallen Grace (passive).
Their build heals off damage: anti-heal (the Tainted items) cuts it.
Serath dealt 35,084 hero damage, 27% of their team's, with +157 physical power from items.

Penetration: Manta Scythe 10; against Boris (level 14: about 89 physical armor, 79 after penetration; took 19,686 physical damage from heroes, 72% of all hero damage they took) and Steel (level 13: about 139 physical armor, 129 after penetration; took 18,545 physical damage from heroes, 48% of all hero damage they took) that is about 6% and 4% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Manta Scythe (item): Against Enemy Units within 2500u: If they have no Ally within 1000u of themselves, deal 8% more damage to them.
Sky Splitter (item): On Successful Basic Attacks: Deal 5% of Target's Current Health as Damage On-Hit. Reduced to 3.5% for Ranged Heroes. Minimum of 12 Damage.
Rapture (item): While within 475u of an Enemy Unit: Your Basic Attacks deal 20 (+2.5%)(+15%) Damage On-Hit to them.
Storm Breaker (item): While moving or landing Basic Attacks: Generate stacks of Momentum. At 100 stacks empower your next Basic Attack On-Hit. Release a bolt of lightning that chains to 7 Targets.
Pacifier (crest): Dash a short distance. Empower your next Physical Damage Instance within 3s. Deals 30 (+25%) Damage. Increased by 2.5x against Targets below 20% Max Health.
Vermis (Eternal): Every 3rd consecutive Basic Attack on the same Enemy Hero within 2.5s deals 3% (+0.25% per Level) of their Max Health as bonus Physical Damage.
Serration (Eternal minor): Vermis also deals 3.5% of the target's Missing Health as bonus Physical Damage.
Melting Point (Eternal minor): Deal 10% bonus damage to targets with more than 125 Physical Armor.
Sustain: 21% lifesteal; 7% omnivamp; 8,657 healing recorded.
Toughness: +600 health, +40 physical armor; took 41,171 damage, mitigated 28,536, died 6 times.

(game text: Vermis also deals 3.5% of the target's Missing Health as bonus Physical Damage.) Field: 44.6% in 148 games, 80% of picks, below the hero-role's 49.2%.

Loadout minor Melting Point: Bonus damage against targets with high physical armor. Take it when the enemy front line is stacking armor. (game text: Deal 10% bonus damage to targets with more than 125 Physical Armor.) Field: 50% in 70 games, 38% of picks, level the hero-role's 49.2%.

(game text: Adrenalize:  Dash a short distance. Empower your next Physical Damage Instance within 3s. Deals 30 (+25%) Damage. Increased by 2.5x against Targets below 20% Max Health. Killing a Hero within 3s allows Adrenalize to be recast for 6s.) Field: 49.7% in 768 games, 10% of picks, level the hero-role's 49.2%.
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 6 effects on one trigger: Manta Scythe, Sky Splitter, Rapture, Storm Breaker, Vermis, Wrath Unleashed.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 4 effects on one trigger: Manta Scythe, Sky Splitter, Rapture, Pacifier.

Stack (Kept alive in fights): 4 effects on one trigger: Citadel, Pacifier, Vermis, Melting Point. Together they made staying in a long fight cheaper: more armor, shields or healing the longer it went.

Stack (Damage that scales with the target's health): 2 effects on one trigger: Sky Splitter, Serration. The more health a target stacks, the more these deal, so health items on the other side fed them.

The Eternal was part of it: Vermis (Serration + Melting Point) sits on the same triggers as the items (every basic attack set off; kept alive in fights; damage that scales with the target's health), so the same hits paid out twice.
Countered? 1 of the 4 players Serath killed built physical armor (Steel). Anti-heal on Shinbi, Steel. Health items on Boris, Steel raised the %-health damage they took. We killed Serath 6 times.
Copy it? Vermis: 47.3% in 186 Serath jungle games, below the hero's 49.2%. It wins less than usual elsewhere: it beat us, not the field.

lines: Lead story: Damage well above normal. 1,369 hero damage a minute, more than 85% of Eden offlane players this patch (28% of the team's). The damage came from Imperator, Viper, Eviscerator.
Eden dealt 36,965 hero damage, 28% of their team's, with +192 physical power from items.

Penetration: Vanquisher 12, Viper 8; against Shinbi (level 15: about 145 physical armor, 125 after penetration; took 25,470 physical damage from heroes, 91% of all hero damage they took) and Boris (level 14: about 89 physical armor, 69 after penetration; took 19,686 physical damage from heroes, 72% of all hero damage they took) that is about 9% and 12% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Imperator (item): Critical Strikes deal 30% more damage.
Viper (item): Against Eroded Heroes: Deal 10% increased On-Hit and Ability damage.
Eviscerator (crest): Gain 20% Attack Speed and 8% Omnivamp for 6s. Empower your Basic Attacks to deal (+10%) Damage On-Hit for 6s.
Vermis (Eternal): Every 3rd consecutive Basic Attack on the same Enemy Hero within 2.5s deals 3% (+0.25% per Level) of their Max Health as bonus Physical Damage.
Serration (Eternal minor): Vermis also deals 3.5% of the target's Missing Health as bonus Physical Damage.
Melting Point (Eternal minor): Deal 10% bonus damage to targets with more than 125 Physical Armor.
Kinetic Waltz (augment): Axiom Strike deals 90% damage, has 30% reduced cooldown and grants 35% movement speed for 1.5s when damaging Enemy Heroes.
Sustain: 7% lifesteal; 4,275 healing recorded.

Loadout augment Kinetic Waltz: Melee Axiom Strike hits a bit softer but comes back much sooner and gives a burst of speed on hero hits. Built for staying in claw stance and spinning through fights repeatedly. (game text: Axiom Strike deals 90% damage, has 30% reduced cooldown and grants 35% movement speed for 1.5s when damaging Enemy Heroes.) Field: 47.8% in 324 games, 29% of picks, below the hero-role's 48.9%.

Loadout Eternal Vermis: Every third basic attack on the same hero adds damage based on their max health. Eden's ranged gun fires very fast, so it procs constantly, making this strong into tanks. (game text: Every 3rd consecutive Basic Attack on the same Enemy Hero within 2.5s deals 3% (+0.25% per Level) of their Max Health as bonus Physical Damage.) Field: 42.6% in 235 games, 21% of picks, below the hero-role's 48.9%.

Loadout minor Serration: Adds missing-health damage on top of Vermis procs. The more you have already hurt the target, the harder each third hit lands, helping finish fights. (game text: Vermis also deals 3.5% of the target's Missing Health as bonus Physical Damage.) Field: 43.1% in 232 games, 99% of picks, below the hero-role's 48.9%.

Loadout minor Melting Point: Extra damage only into enemies stacked with physical armor. Pick it when the enemy team has tanks building armor; otherwise it does little. (game text: Deal 10% bonus damage to targets with more than 125 Physical Armor.) Field: 42.9% in 210 games, 89% of picks, below the hero-role's 48.9%.

Loadout crest Eviscerator: A burst of attack speed, healing on all damage, and extra on-hit damage for 6s. Eden turns attack speed into physical power, so this spikes both her speed and her hit strength in a fight. (game text: Rending Strikes:  Gain 20% Attack Speed and 8% Omnivamp for 6s. Empower your Basic Attacks to deal (+10%) Damage On-Hit for 6s.) Field: 41% in 105 games, 9% of picks, below the hero-role's 48.9%.
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 4 effects on one trigger: Dust Devil, Viper, Eviscerator, Vermis.
Stack (Kept alive in fights): 3 effects on one trigger: Viper, Vermis, Melting Point. Together they made staying in a long fight cheaper: more armor, shields or healing the longer it went.
The Eternal was part of it: Vermis (Serration + Melting Point) sits on the same triggers as the items (every basic attack set off; kept alive in fights), so the same hits paid out twice.
Countered? 2 of the 3 players Eden killed built physical armor (Shinbi, Steel). We killed Eden 6 times.
Copy it? Vermis (Serration + Melting Point): 43.3% in 208 Eden offlane games, below the hero's 48.9%. It wins less than usual elsewhere: it beat us, not the field.
